content: प्रतियोगिन् {%a.%} .²1 Opposing, counteracting, impeding. .²2 Related or corresponding to, being or forming a counter-part of (anything); often used in works on Nyāya; as a घट is the प्रतियोगी of घटाभाव; (यस्याभावो विवक्ष्यते स प्रतियोगी). .²3 Co-operating with. .²4 Equally matched. --{%m.%} .²1 An adversary, opponent, enemy; आर्थो विरोधः शक्तेन जातो नः प्रतियोगिना <ls>Mv. 2. 7</ls>; दहत्यशेषं प्रतियोगिगर्वम् <ls>Vikr. 1. 117</ls>. .²2 A counter-part, match. .²3 A partner, an associate. .²4 An object dependent upon another. .²5 A counter-part, counter-entity; प्रतियोगिज्ञानाधीनज्ञानविषयत्वमभावलक्षणम्.
